description: This file is a Perl test script for the Lighttpd web server, specifically testing the FastCGI module behavior and various HTTP request handling scenarios.

classes.name: LightyTest
classes.description: A class providing methods to facilitate testing Lighttpd by starting/stopping processes and handling HTTP requests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new LightyTest instance.

methods.name: get_ephemeral_tcp_port
methods.description: Static method to get a temporary TCP port for testing.

methods.name: start_proc
methods.description: Method to start the Lighttpd server with the specified configuration.

methods.name: handle_http
methods.description: Method to send an HTTP request and handle the response within the test.

methods.name: listening_on
methods.description: Method to check if Lighttpd is listening on the specified port.

methods.name: stop_proc
methods.description: Method to stop the running Lighttpd process.
